title: AM62x Edge AI Vision Demo
description: Real-time object detection and classification on AM62x using TFLite runtime with GStreamer pipeline. Supports camera input and display output on Starter Kit EVM.

title: AM64x Motor Control SDK
description: High-voltage 3-phase BLDC/PMSM motor drive reference using AM64x PRU-ICSSG. Achieves sub-microsecond real-time control loop with SIL2 safety readiness.

title: AM62x Android HMI Starter
description: Android Automotive OS HMI starter application for AM62x. Demonstrates GPU-accelerated UI rendering, multi-display support, and IVI cluster integration.

title: AM64x Industrial Protocol Gateway
description: Multi-protocol industrial gateway using AM64x PRU-ICSSG. Supports EtherCAT, PROFINET, EtherNet/IP and Modbus with deterministic sub-100µs cycle time.

title: AM62Ax Vision Analytics Pipeline
description: Multi-camera analytics pipeline on AM62Ax MMA accelerator. Runs YOLO-based detection at 30fps with semantic segmentation on a single 2W device.

title: AM62Px Dual-Display Instrument Cluster
description: Automotive dual-display cluster and IVI split-screen demo on AM62Px. Demonstrates DSS8 display sharing, GPU compositing, and CAN signal integration.

title: AM65x TSN Switch Demo
description: IEEE 802.1Qbv Time-Sensitive Networking switch demo on AM65x ICSSG. Demonstrates scheduled traffic, preemption, and CBS with hardware timestamping.

title: AM62x Secure Boot & OTA Update
description: End-to-end secure boot chain with code signing, OP-TEE secure enclave, and over-the-air update using hawkBit on AM62x SK-EVM.

title: AM67A Deep Learning Robotics
description: ROS 2 robotics stack with deep-learning-based perception on AM67A. Demonstrates point cloud processing, LiDAR fusion, and autonomous navigation.

title: AM64x Functional Safety IEC 62443
description: Safety-capable diagnostic framework for AM64x targeting IEC 62443 / SIL2. Includes CPU, memory, and peripheral self-test libraries with FreeRTOS integration.
